messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal statutory holidays that create a 3‑day “long weekend” in Canada for 2023**.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the day‑off is usually observed on the following Monday, which is why the dates shown are the *observed* dates.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick) | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday nationwide. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Nationwide. |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Monday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Canada Day falls on Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Nationwide. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Nationwide. |
| **Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | **Nov 11–13** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Observed on Monday because Nov 11 is Saturday. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Nationwide. |

### Quick Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates | Holiday |
|--------------|-------|---------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| **Victoria Day** | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day (observed) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11–13 | Remembrance Day (observed) |
| **Christmas** | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. not in Quebec), add a lookup table per province.  
> • For holidays that fall on a weekend, use the *observed* date (the following Monday) to calculate the long‑weekend span.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional holidays (e.g., provincial holidays like St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador).
